# staark patch

A stateless DOM renderer for Staark abstract node trees. Use it when application state and update scheduling are managed elsewhere.

## `prepare`

```TypeScript
prepare(
  rootElement: HTMLElement | Element | string,
  oldAbstractTree?: NodeContent[] | string | null,
): (newAbstractTree: NodeContent[] | NodeContent) => unknown
```

Creates a patch function bound to a root element. A string root is resolved as a query selector. Calling the returned function reconciles the new abstract tree with the previous tree and updates the DOM.

The optional old tree supports client-side hydration. When it is a string, it is parsed as serialized JSON. Use stable, sibling-unique `key` attributes to preserve DOM element identity when keyed children are inserted, removed, or reordered; keys are reconciliation metadata and are not written to the DOM.

## Node helpers

The base build exports `node` and `prepare`. The full build also exports `conditional`, `factory`, `fctory`, `identifier`, `match`, and `nde`.

```TypeScript
node(
  type: string,
  attributes?: Record<string, any>,
  children?: NodeContent[] | NodeContent,
): NodeAbstract
```

## Example

```JavaScript
import { node, prepare } from '@doars/staark-patch'

const patch = prepare('#app')

patch(node('p', 'First render'))
patch(node('p', 'Updated render'))
```
